fusions.name: Heel-Nip Drive
fusions.desc: Nips at the target's heels for 13 damage, drives it back 3 tiles and leaves it 10% easier to wound for 5 seconds.

fusions.name: Murrain
fusions.desc: Rats foul the ground around you, dealing 7 damage to every enemy within 3 tiles, with a 50% chance to leave each [Diseased] for 6 seconds. The disease spreads on its own to up to 2 more enemies within 4 tiles. Holds 3 charges, and each kill gives one back.

fusions.name: Byre Warmth
fusions.desc: Lays a nest of warm straw where you stand. For 8 seconds it restores 3 health a second to you and any ally inside it.

fusions.name: Fat on Feed Corn
fusions.desc: Your maximum health rises by 12, and you regain 0.5 health a second.
